judged_text: The 'tells the topic retriever to work' test asserts TopicRetriever.new(...).retrieve is called, but EmbedController#best (app/controllers/embed_controller.rb line 15) never calls TopicRetriever — it calls Jobs.enqueue(:retrieve_topic, ...); the spec verifies a mock contract that does not exist in the code under test. If Jobs.enqueue is not inline in the test environment, this test fails or (with inline jobs) exercises the real RetrieveTopic job path — which calls TopicEmbed.import_remote and performs open(url) against the network — rather than verifying the controller's actual enqueue call; a regression that changes the enqueued job name or its arguments (user_id, embed_url) goes undetected because the test asserts the wrong collaborator entirely.

adjudication.rationale: The diff shows EmbedController#best enqueues a job when no embed exists: `Jobs.enqueue(:retrieve_topic, user_id: ..., embed_url: embed_url)` (app/controllers/embed_controller.rb). It never instantiates or calls `TopicRetriever`. However, the new controller spec `"tells the topic retriever to work when no previous embed is found"` expects `TopicRetriever.new(...).retrieve` to be invoked. This expectation cannot be satisfied by the controller code and will cause the test to fail (and it also wouldn’t detect regressions in the enqueued job name/args).
